newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil scraps today's CVRD auction--bolsa.
newsitem.headline: Brazil scraps today's CVRD auction--bolsa.

text.p: Brazil scrapped the privatization auction of state miner Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) that had been rescheduled for today, a spokeswoman for the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange said.
She said the Rio bolsa and Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) had suspended preparations for the auction.
"Today there will be no auction for sure," the spokeswoman said.

The decision came after a judge of the Superior Court of Justice (STJ) said he would not rule before Monday on a government appeal that all injunctions against the CVRD sale be handled by a single court.
Justice Democrito Reinaldo told reporters on Thursday that he would examine the case over the weekend and might have a decision on Monday.
An STJ decision in the government's favor would allow the government to move to quickly overturn injunctions granted by several different courts.

The CVRD auction was originally scheduled for Tuesday. The auction, the biggest in Latin America to date, has been delayed by a host of legal challenges. A maximum 45 percent stake in the mining conglomerate is to be sold.
